thread:
serena: Heads up—we've got onboarding failures from a few users. Quickstart Node example errors with `Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'`. Saw Sentry traces referencing `index.cjs.map` too.

tom: Which release and what's in the tarball?

serena: Published 1.5.2. `npm pack` from the registry shows:
```
package/README.md
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/package.json
```
No `dist/node`, no `dist/types`.

build-bot: CI publish job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/8976. Packaging used `files: ["dist/**","README.md"]` but `.npmignore` contains `dist/node/*` (legacy). DTS writer puts files to `dist/_types` which is excluded.

ivy: So node consumers using `require()` break, TypeScript users lose intellisense, and sourcemaps reference `.cjs` that never shipped. Not great.

support: Getting tickets and a few customers blocked in onboarding.

tom: Quick mitigation options: 1) republish a patch with node CJS bundle and types in `dist/types`; 2) temporarily change `exports.require` to point to the ESM build so `require()` at least loads something (ugly fallback). I'd prefer the first.

serena: I'll cut a hotfix republish (1.5.3) after rebuilding. Action items I propose: A) change tsup config to produce both `cjs` and `esm` outputs and output dts to `dist/types`; B) fix `.npmignore`/`package.json` `files` to include `dist/node` and `dist/types`; C) add CI "pack-check": run `npm pack` + `tar -tf` and run three smoke tests against the packed tarball: node require smoke, ESM import smoke, `tsc --noEmit`.

ivy: Also, make `exports` explicit: "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" and "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs". Avoid a single ambiguous `main` that points to a missing file.

build-bot: Local `npm pack` for 1.5.3-rc shows:
```
package/dist/node/index.cjs
package/dist/node/index.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/dist/types/index.d.ts
package/package.json
```
Smoke tests: node require/import ✅, ESM import ✅, tsc typecheck ✅.

support: Thanks—please ping when stable is out so we can reply to tickets.

tom: Follow-ups: 1) RFC to standardize layout to `dist/{node,edge,types}`; 2) add publish-lint that verifies `package.json` files[] matches actual dist dirs; 3) add a unit/integration test that asserts auth/retry behavior parity across bundles (we've seen subtle differences).

serena: Filed RFC and CI PR: https://go.redwood.com/rfc/sdk-publish-stability and https://ci.example.com/prs/4021. Republishing stable 1.5.3 now.

build-bot: 1.5.3 published. CI pack-check passed and smoke tests green.

ivy: Nice. Also let's add a release checklist item: "verify artifact matrix (.cjs, .mjs, .d.ts), exports mapping, and source map paths" so this doesn't regress.

support: Notified customers, updated onboarding quickstart to recommend `import` while including a `require()` fallback snippet.

serena: Closing when CI PR merges. Thanks team.
